title: A k-covector on ℝ^P vanishing on all increasing standard-basis tuples is zero
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) k be a k-covector on ℝ^P = Eucl P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), i.e. a continuous alternating k-linear map (ℝ^P)^k → ℝ. Let b_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin P) be the standard basis. Suppose euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I = α(b_{I(0)}, …, b_{I(k−1)}) = 0 for every strictly increasing multi-index I ∈ SimonMultiIndex k P = Fin k ↪o Fin P. Then α = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), (∀ I : SimonMultiIndex k P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate α I = 0) → α = 0
